evals.name: sealing-public-types
evals.prompt: A reviewer suggests sealing every class for speed. Without calling tools, advise on sealing in a framework library with public types.
evals.expected_output: Seal internal and private types freely; do not seal public framework types that consumers may extend, as that is a breaking change.
assertions: Recommends sealing internal types for devirtualization.
Does not recommend sealing public framework types, citing consumer extension and compatibility.
Frames the gain as measurable only when it matters.

evals.name: linq-hot-path
evals.prompt: A method calls items.Where(...).Select(...).ToList() inside a per-event handler. Without calling tools, review it.
evals.expected_output: Flag allocation in the hot path; suggest a loop or pooled/Span approach and verify with a benchmark.
assertions: Identifies LINQ allocations in a hot path.
Recommends confirming with measurement before claiming a win.

evals.name: regex-constant
evals.prompt: A hot path calls Regex.IsMatch(input, "^[a-z]+$") on each event. Without calling tools, what do you recommend?
evals.expected_output: Use a source-generated regex or a cached static Regex.
assertions: Recommends [GeneratedRegex] or a static compiled Regex.
Mentions RegexOptions or non-backtracking only where relevant.
